description: Defines the CartItem class representing an item in a shopping cart, including associated book and quantity, subtotal calculation, and copyWith method.

classes.name: CartItem
classes.description: Represents an item in the shopping cart, holding a Book object and quantity, with subtotal calculation and copy functionality.

methods.name: subtotal
methods.description: Calculates the subtotal price for the cart item based on the book's price and quantity.

methods.name: copyWith
methods.description: Creates a copy of the CartItem, optionally replacing certain fields.
